Questions, answered.

Are these briquettes smokeless or suitable for indoor use?

No smokeless, emissions or indoor-use claim has been confirmed. Burning charcoal produces carbon monoxide; it must not be used inside homes or enclosed spaces.

Can I buy or order this product?

The range is in development. Prices, availability and launch dates are not confirmed. You can inquire about the concept, but the website is not accepting orders.

Where will it be made?

Manufacturing and packing locations have not been confirmed. A South Sudan market focus does not establish a manufacturing location.

Can I inquire about retail or distribution?

Yes. Use the email or WhatsApp buttons to discuss the product or proposed format. Supply arrangements, territories and commercial terms remain unconfirmed.
